subject: actual_browser_end_to_end

environment.power: AC connected; power mode not independently instrumented

referenceDeviceReason: Available machine has 128 GiB; ordinary 16 GiB office device was not available.
memoryMethod: Dedicated Chrome process tree: 100 ms RSS samples plus macOS footprint physical/kernel lifetime peaks for every live descendant at each completion. Reports idle baseline, total physical footprint, sum of process lifetime peaks, and incremental peak above the fixed pre-document baseline. Includes Worker, WASM, native and GPU allocations. Sum of per-process peaks is conservative because peaks may occur at different times; RSS may double-count shared pages. Memory budget uses the declared incremental document-attributable physical peak; total is also retained.
